name: Sigabo
overview:
Eight years after being imprisoned for a murder he did not commit, Gabo is unexpectedly granted parole. On his first day out, he boards a bus bound for home, only to find himself caught in the middle of a robbery orchestrated by his former group. As he fights to survive and protect innocent lives, his long-awaited freedom comes at a greater price—he is forced into a covert government program that recruits convicts for dangerous, high-stakes missions.

—ABS-CBN
